items.headline: Ether near $2,320 as US spot ether ETFs are on pace for about $1.18B of October outflows; Glamsterdam test delayed
items.summary: Per Farside Investors data cited by Crypto Times, spot ether ETFs have had net inflows on only three of 17 October sessions, and BlackRock's ETHA accounts for most of the selling. Separately, core developers postponed the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet (set for Oct 26) to study EIP-8037; no mainnet date is set. Continued outflows and a delayed upgrade weigh on ETH sentiment ahead of Wednesday's Fed decision.
